newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to levy road tax on local motorists.
newsitem.headline: Romania to levy road tax on local motorists.

text.p: Romania's Transport Ministry has decided to levy a road tax on local motorists, with plans to create a special fund to repair the country's battered infrastructure, the state news agency Rompres said on Monday.
Rompres quoted Transport Minister Traian Basescu as saying the new road tax would be charged starting June.
Under the new rules, motorists driving vehicles with a capacity of up to 1,500 cubic centimetres would pay a tax amounting to 50,000 lei a year, Rompres said.
Vehicles with capacities from 1,500 to 2,000 ccm would be taxed with 100,000 lei, while taxes for vehicles with capacities exceeding 2,000 cc would amount to 1.4 million lei.

Rompres also said the ministry had planned to put the 2.5 trillion lei resulted from road taxes into a special fund to finance part of the repairs needed by Romania's road network. Data show some 70 percent of the country's 14,500 km (9,000 miles) of roads are in bad shape.
